name: route_presentation
description: Which composition pattern, and optionally which published presentation_template, an institution-owned public route wears for one explicitly installed tenant territory. Design inputs arrive as owner-bound route and presentation_template rows; the native renderer stays generic. Presentation reads no subject, grants no action and owns no route, which stays with its canonical page owner. Territory values are validated against the installed tenant host contract rather than an Aurekai-only list; status is draft, published or retired.
